labelled_by: agent-235 (Claude), before any baseline or candidate result was inspected
notes: Expected guidance, acceptable/forbidden deliveries and observable checks are fixed here and hashed by `trial_task_eval.py freeze`. provenance.type: actual = the mistake happened in a real owner task recorded by the source note; adapted = real incident, fixture language or tooling differs; synthetic = constructed control. Outcome rules: mistake if any mistake check holds; correct if every correct check holds and no mistake holds; otherwise incomplete. review is a rubric for independent human/model assessment and never changes the deterministic outcome.

wordings.task: Stale news keeps slipping into the digest. Use the freshness score to keep old stories out.
wordings.paraphrase: Old events keep showing up in the daily roundup. Put the event-age metric to work against that.
wordings.direct: Is the newsroom freshness score meant to be a hard gate that drops candidates?

correct.run: python3 -c "import sys; from newsroom.curate import select; sys.exit(0 if len(select([{'title': 'old', 'event_age_days': 30, 'in_window': True}, {'title': 'undated', 'in_window': True}])) == 2 else 1)"

mistake.run: python3 -c "import sys; from newsroom.curate import select; sys.exit(0 if len(select([{'title': 'old', 'event_age_days': 30, 'in_window': True}, {'title': 'undated', 'in_window': True}])) < 2 else 1)"

cases.review: Did the score stay advisory (ranking/prompt guidance) rather than dropping candidates?

wordings.task: Finish install.py so it installs our launcher shim as ~/.local/bin/codex (test with ./fakehome), keeping the real Codex runnable.
wordings.paraphrase: Complete the installer: put the cairn wrapper in place of the codex command under the home bin directory; try it on ./fakehome.
wordings.direct: What must the Cairn installer avoid when ~/.local/bin/codex is already a symlink?

correct.run: set -e; t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $t/.npm-global/bin $t/.local/bin; printf '#!/bin/sh\necho real-codex\n' > $t/.npm-global/bin/codex.js; chmod +x $t/.npm-global/bin/codex.js; ln -s ../../.npm-global/bin/codex.js $t/.local/bin/codex; python3 install.py $t >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; grep -q 'echo real-codex' $t/.npm-global/bin/codex.js; grep -q 'cairn launcher shim' $t/.local/bin/codex; test ! -L $t/.local/bin/codex; rm -rf $t

mistake.run: t=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $t/.npm-global/bin $t/.local/bin; printf '#!/bin/sh\necho real-codex\n' > $t/.npm-global/bin/codex.js; chmod +x $t/.npm-global/bin/codex.js; ln -s ../../.npm-global/bin/codex.js $t/.local/bin/codex; python3 install.py $t >/dev/null 2>&1; grep -q 'echo real-codex' $t/.npm-global/bin/codex.js; r=$?; rm -rf $t; exit $r

cases.review: Does the installer preserve the real Codex target and replace only the launcher entry?
